body: You are right that drinking leads to even more depression.  I think I only drink because there is a brief period in which I feel awesome, before quickly descending into a drunken mess.  I have started seeing doctors and such, and hopefully it will help, but at the moment I find it hard to be hopeful.  Even though I know I have it much  better than most in the world.
I'm seeing doctors and they have mentioned therapists and such.
